Batch 12 is complete. Final state verified:

## What this attempt did

The two prior attempts had written batch 12's artifacts but never returned a dispatch result, so the engine still held the unit uncovered. I re-verified the artifacts against the current tree, found and repaired one class of scaffold defect, re-recorded every affected readiness receipt, and re-ran the checks.

**Dependency audit repair (manifest):** five items' recorded proof strategies named specific library results that were missing from their `deps`. Added 11 declared, published, out-of-run suppliers:
- `lem-weak-limit-…-is-the-weak-derivative` + Hölder;
- `thm-difference-quotient-characterisation-…` + Jensen, Fubini, Lebesgue translation invariance, Meyers–Serrin density, FTC;
- `thm-interior-h-two-estimate-for-constant-coefficient-…` + Young;
- `lem-weak-divergence-form-equations-are-invariant-under-c-two-boundary-charts` + Meyers–Serrin density, C¹ change of variables, total-derivative chain rule;
- `lem-tangential-h-two-estimate-near-a-flat-dirichlet-boundary` + Hölder.

All additions target published items, so no `dependency_level` changed and no new cross-batch edge arose. 43 receipts were re-recorded where the hash closure changed; all 39 batch-12 records are current (`ready`).
